patching.population: clean-correct receiver and clean-correct donor within the same seed
patching.frozen_condition_source: original V4.4 causal-v2 overall stability selection
patching.primary_accuracy: mean(strict_target_hit), where strict_target_hit is patched_count == donor_gold_count and invalid generations score zero
patching.secondary_accuracy: mean(patched_is_correct), where correctness is relative to the receiver gold count

ablation.all_examples_population: reuse the original n=1..32 discovery sweep without correctness filtering
ablation.correct_only_population: clean baseline is exact and format-valid before ablation
ablation.selection_rule: report all candidate doses and cluster-bootstrap intervals; do not automatically freeze top_n
ablation.confirmation_rule: after human review freezes model- and population-specific top_n, use a disjoint unused fresh-seed suffix for confirmation

missing_numeric_policy.signed_count_shift: undefined for invalid patched generations; report valid denominator and valid rate
missing_numeric_policy.absolute_error_delta: use the registered V4.4 intervention outcome definition
